item.title: Iya Soba: Rustic Mountain Buckwheat Noodles — Guide
item.description: Iya soba is the traditional buckwheat noodle of the Iya Valley, born of necessity in a place too steep and cold for rice. On the near-vertical mountain slopes, hardy buckwheat was one of the few crops that would grow, and the local people made it into a distinctive soba: because the flour was often used without much binding wheat, the noodles are short, thick, roughly cut and rustic, with a robust, nutty buckwheat flavour quite different from the long, refined soba of the cities.
